slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

lunch with someone new

this month, invite one coworker or classmate you barely know to lunch. nine times out of ten they say yes, and you learn that people are far less scary up close.

the one who sums up

at the end of a meeting or a group chat, be the one who sums up what was decided. the person who closes the conversation is the one everyone remembers as in charge.

still hands

when you talk this week, keep your hands still or move them slowly, no fidgeting with your phone or sleeves. calm hands make you look sure, and soon you start feeling it.

learning streak

keep a learning streak: 5 minutes a day on art, science or history, no days off. a small promise kept daily builds self trust, and the knowledge makes you calm in any conversation.

karaoke once a month

do karaoke once this month, ideally a song you barely know. one minute of being bad in front of people does more for your confidence than a whole year of hiding.
